title: Darktide's Depths Of The Damned Update Arrives September 29 - NewsBreak
text:
By Franz Christian Irorita ,
3 hours ago
Warhammer 40,000: Darktide ‘s next free update, Depths of the Damned , arrives September 29, sending strike teams back to Tertium to push deeper into the Hive than the game has taken players before. The update centers on a new mini story campaign culminating in a brand-new mission, Spillway, alongside six new weapons and a mysterious new enemy.
Quick Facts Price: Free update for all players Release Date: September 29, 2026 Platforms: PC (Steam), PS5, Xbox Series X/S Developer: Fatshark Publisher: Fatshark Spillway Sends Strike Teams Into the Water Cartel’s Territory Spillway takes players into the domain of the Water Cartel, a sprawling network of tunnels, waterways, and forgotten passages crawling with chaos and decay. The mission isn’t a straight line from start to finish; strike teams have to choose their route carefully, since some paths through the labyrinth are considerably more dangerous than others.
The update adds six new weapons across both new families and new marks of existing ones. Three entirely new weapon families arrive: the Ogryn Cruncher, the Huntsman’s Shotgun, and the Ogryn Thugshot. Alongside them, four new weapon marks join existing families: the Crusher Krourk MK VII, the Double-Barrelled Shotgun Krourk Mk IV, the Gromm Mk I Battle Maul, and the Mk V Slab Shield, spreading new options across a range of playable classes.
A New Threat Lurks in the Torrent Deep within the Hive, players will encounter the Prophet of Decay, a powerful Psyker enemy. We don’t know much about this Psyker as Fatshark is keeping their cards close ahead of launch. The studio has confirmed only that the Prophet has made the depths of the Torrent its domain and is no ordinary spawn of Chaos, leaving exactly what awaits strike teams in the dark until the update actually goes live and they see for themselves.
Depths of the Damned also brings a new live event, a store rotation, and general quality-of-life improvements, following the Bound by Duty update and December’s Hive Scum class launch as the latest in Fatshark’s steady content cadence for the game.
Fatshark has said dedicated Feature Highlights covering the new weapons in more depth are still to come ahead of the September 29 release.
